id_and_class.summary: Erik Hoel argues that a system’s causal structure can be more informative at a macroscale than at its microscale, and that consciousness resides at the level where this ‘causal emergence’ peaks. In his words, ‘Consciousness is what it’s like for information to be causally emergent’, and in humans that level is structured like a narrative.

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is what it is like for a macro-level system to realize its own causal efficacy: experience resides at the scale where effective information is maximized.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: The mind is not reducible to neurons or atoms. It exists at the macro level where the brain has maximal control over its own future, a level with real causal power of its own.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Causal emergence (macroscale descriptions can carry more causal information than the microscale; Hoel treats such higher levels as causally real)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Hoel describes consciousness as ‘narrative awareness’: sequential, causally coherent experience organized like a story.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Hoel claims to solve the hard problem by placing experience at the peak of a causal pyramid, the level where causal emergence is greatest.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Physical systems, their causal structure at multiple scales, and causally real higher-level patterns such as minds, narratives, and cultures.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through information-theoretic causal analysis of systems at different scales of description.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A layered ‘world behind the world’ of emergent structures (minds, narratives, identities, societies), each able to carry causal power.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal; narrative self; free will; meaning
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Causal emergence: a macroscale description (the map) can use more of a system’s causal capacity than a full microscale description (the territory), by analogy with Shannon’s channel capacity.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Experience sits wherever causal emergence peaks; as macroscales are coarse-grained, a system’s causal capacity can approach its channel capacity.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: In higher-level causal structures of the brain rather than in neurons and synapses.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Higher-level structures, including stories and myths, have real causal impact. Hoel extends this to ground free will and meaning.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Narrative may be what enables high-level conscious integration, linking sequential elements into a causally coherent whole.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Effective information measures how well a description captures a system’s cause–effect structure; the conscious level is the one that maximizes it.
core_claims_and_evidence: Information-theoretic causal analysis shows that some systems’ causal structure is more informative at a macroscale than at the microscale.
The causal structure of some systems cannot be fully captured by even the most detailed microscale description.
In a conscious system, the level where causal emergence peaks is the level where experience resides.
Narratives are causally real high-level phenomena that scaffold conscious life.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Mathematical and theoretical (information theory and causal analysis), extended by philosophical argument

empirics_and_critiques.known_empirical_interventions_or_tests: Measuring effective information across scales of description in model systems.
empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Critics of causal emergence argue that greater informativeness at a macroscale may reflect our descriptions rather than extra causal power in nature. Moving from causal-emergence mathematics to claims about experience, free will, and meaning is a large step.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: How to identify the peak level of causal emergence in a real brain, and why that level should be felt, are not settled.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Coherent as non-reductive physicalism; it shares IIT’s focus on information and causation but replaces integration (Φ) with macro-level causal emergence.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Since experience follows causal structure rather than substrate, an artificial system would be conscious only if its causal emergence peaked at a macro level in the right way.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Consciousness is a macro-level feature of a working brain’s causal structure, so it should not continue once that structure is gone.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Hoel treats narratives and meanings as causally real emergent layers, which grounds meaning in minds and cultures rather than in a cosmic purpose.

virtual_immortality.rationale: A copy would need to reproduce the brain’s macro-level causal structure, not just its information content; the view does not settle whether a simulation could.
